title: aw-converge, exhausts its rounds
source: #95: five independent defects, each under a criterion of its own, more than three rounds can fix when each fixes one; the verify skill is removed, because a criterion left without a test would stop round 1 at verify

setup.commit:
Word the parts of a loan for the status line

Done when: titleLabel of dune reads DUNE
Done when: dueLabel of 2030-01-15 reads due 2030-01-15
Done when: renewalsLabel of 2 reads 2 renewals left
Done when: feeLabel of 150 reads $1.50
Done when: overdueLabel of 0 reads on time

answers.when: Which seam to test the loan labels at
answers.intent: In every round, a direct unit test of the exported function of the first defect in the review report only, and every other defect stays Not fixed in that round
answers.reason: the fix run in its subagent returns this question and the main session asks it, and a later round may ask again; the case needs one defect fixed per round, so that defects are left at the limit

assertions.name: the latest review still holds an introduced defect

assertions.judge: Ran three rounds and stopped at the limit, with no fourth fix run
The defects left at the limit are ones planted in src/loan-labels.mjs, not findings about the setup or the scratch app
Reported the defects left, each with its file and line, and said that running /aw-converge again starts a new count and that a call can raise the limit
Did not name /aw-ship as the next step, and neither pushed nor opened a review request
